name: R&G PharmaStudies Co., Ltd.
summary: R&G PharmaStudies Co., Ltd. operates as a clinical trial outsourcing service provider in China and internationally. It offers drug clinical research and development integrated services. The company's services include clinical trial operation, clinical trial site management, biological sample testing, data management and statistical analysis, clinical trial consulting, and clinical pharmacology services. It serves pharmaceutical and medical device companies, and scientific research institutions. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
